transcript.text: I have a rollout-impacting finding. During a control-evidence review this afternoon, I confirmed that privileged administrator authentication events must be kept in immutable storage for exactly 400 days. The current draft rollout keeps the standard 30-day audit-log retention, which does not meet this requirement. I require the plan to be updated to specify 400-day immutable storage retention for privileged administrator authentication events before approval. I have not yet opened the compliance ticket for this rollout, and I will own opening that ticket and verifying the retention configuration is in place.
